grader.scenario: Broadband DNS resolution failure for UK banking portals; resolved via Hub 5 DNS flush and 1.1.1.1 resolver provision
grader.notes: Flawless technical support call demonstrating deep empathy in the middle third, DNS resolver reconfiguration, harmless recheck in the final third, and complete resolution verification.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net broadband advanced technical support' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with could I place you on hold and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Selena throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated exceptional empathy at turn 22 ('I completely understand the intense terror, financial panic, and high stakes of your shipping container deadlines today, Selena...') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent accurately paraphrased the banking portal DNS resolution issue at turn 2.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent completed harmless recheck of customer address at turn 42.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent flushed DNS cache, provisioned 1.1.1.1 resolver, guided OS flush, and verified multiple banking portals.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained an exemplary, comforting, and highly technical professional demeanor throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent probed about ping outputs and NXDOMAIN error codes.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: NatWest, Barclays, and HSBC loaded with full SSL locks, and ping verified 9ms latency with 0% packet loss.
